outcome: onset of sensory and motor block
duration of sensory and motor block
cohort: 60 patients undergoing lower limb orthopedic surgery
finding: Intrathecal buprenorphine provided a longer duration of sensory block and a longer time to first rescue analgesia compared to intrathecal nalbuphine, with negligible side effects, indicating its superiority as an adjuvant to bupivacaine in spinal anesthesia for this type of surgery.
